title: Jazzy Jammy Portuguese Eggs Frittata
description: A delicious Portuguese dish featuring jammy eggs and a flaky crust, perfect for a lazy Sunday breakfast.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and sugar until well combined.
Add the yellow food coloring to the egg mixture and whisk until the color is evenly distributed.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the crumbled bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, then set aside.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the melted butter and cook until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the egg mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the crust is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley and chives.
Serve the frittata hot, garnished with additional parsley and chives if desired.
